item.title: 'Help me!': Video shows attack on student at Theodore High School in Mobile County
item.description: A video posted to X by LibsofTiktok on Friday shows a student being violently assaulted in a Theodore High School bathroom. The video shows that the victim, who did not fight back, was surrounded by four students. He was knocked to the ground and repeatedly punched, while two students stood watch and blocked the entrance of the restroom, and another student videoed the assault, encouraging the attack. item.title: State Rep. Robbins applauds fed move to hold sponsors of immigrants accountable
item.description: U.S. Deputy Secretary of Health and Human Services (HHS) Jim O’Neill sent a letter this week to sponsors of immigrants using welfare or other federal benefits.Now, state lawmakers who had a hard time tracking down sponsors of immigrants last year to find out where they were coming from are breathing a sigh of relief. If you are a sponsor of an immigrant who uses welfare or other taxpayer-funded benefits, you are responsible for the cost. This week, I sent letters to sponsors demanding repayment.

item.title: Velma's bar shooting leaves one dead in Trussville
item.description: The Trussville Police Department responded to a deadly shooting in the parking lot of Velma’s bar early Saturday.The Trussville Tribune reported the shooting occurred at 1:05 a.m.A man suffering from gunshot wounds. The victim died despite first responders immediately rendering aid.A man was taken into custody but has not been identified.Velma’s was a mainstay in Trussville until it closed in 2012. item.title: 4 takeaways from No. 21 Auburn basketball's 88-60 loss to No. 6 Purdue
